fields.label: Patient ID
fields.description: The same patient identifier used elsewhere in this app's payloads (e.g. Call Logs.patient / start_consultation's uhis_patient_id) -- not a Link, since this must record the decline even when the client-supplied id never resolved to a local Patient record.

fields.label: Visit ID
fields.description: The visit/encounter the consent was shown during, if any.

fields.label: Language
fields.description: The language the SK actually saw -- not necessarily the app's current default, since get_consent can fall back to English when the requested language has no configured row.

fields.label: Consent Version
fields.description: The exact Shukhee Consent Version snapshot the client fetched via get_consent right before this decline -- validated server-side against the client-supplied version_id, not trusted blindly. Left empty if the id didn't resolve to a real row.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: Resolved server-side via the same current_remote_user_id() -> Provider.username lookup shukhee_integration.providers.current_provider() uses -- never trusted from a client-supplied identity.

fields.label: Patient DOB
fields.description: Raw ISO date, for age-visibility in the audit trail -- deliberately just the raw fact, not a derived 'is minor' flag.
